hook.text: Not all surfaces absorb sunlight equally—snow reflects most of it, while asphalt soaks it up.

buildup.text: Albedo measures reflectivity on a scale from 0 (absorbs all) to 1 (reflects all).

discovery.text: Fresh snow has an albedo near 0.9, while ocean water is around 0.06—dark surfaces heat up fast.

twist.text: As ice melts, darker ocean is exposed, absorbing more heat and melting more ice—a feedback loop.

climax.text: This ice-albedo feedback is one of the most powerful amplifiers of warming in polar regions.

punchline.text: Bright ice keeps things cool—lose it, and warming speeds up.
